notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Changes and fixes:

[list]
[*] added a bug report button
[*] fixed music cutting bug
[*] fixed game crash upon enemy movement in some edge cases
[*] updated compendium texts
[*] changed "leave trap" action not to consume unit turn
[*] neutral villages now don't spawn new units when the player unit is on them
[*] neutral villages now only become frightened by adjacent player units
[*] added shortcut for selecting the next unit or village
[*] added shortcut for sleeping and waking up
[*] changed treasure message
[/list]

Thanks for the reports and suggestions! If something was not changed or fixed yet, we are working on it. Wait for the future patches!

notes.title: Lands of Rumour is releasing now!
notes.notes:
Welcome all!

We have waited for this moment eagerly. The full version of the game is available! The last few weeks were a great journey - so many things polished, changed, fixed, and even added!

Go, buy, play, and come back to tell us what you all think - we are waiting!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Lands of Rumour is releasing in two days!
notes.notes:
Welcome all!

Steam Next Fest left us with much to do. We are fixing last bugs, balancing the mechanics, adding some quality-of-life improvements. The release date is 14.03 at 7:00 AM PT.
See you all there!

notes.title: Discord server starting
notes.notes:
Welcome all!

Steam Next Fest is going on, and LoR is participating! The first day wishlist change was bigger than the whole wishlists we collected so far. One is for sure, I wasn't expecting that! We would like to know more what you think about it, so here starts the discord server: https://discord.gg/3e7vAjfh



[b]Changes in demo:
[/b][list]
[*] fixed hunters' trap bug
[*] fixed units not disappearing in clouds
[*] fixed village UI not updating during building destruction
[*] units now take the tile of the enemy's dead unit
[*] fixed fade out between the scenes
[*] fixed wrong damage effects during combat
[*] fixed unit remaining visible after enemy's unit death
[*] fixed village name labels causing some input issues
[/list]

notes.title: 2nd round of playtests has just started!
notes.notes:
Welcome all!

The playtests are going on. Thanks to the responses, we made many improvements and now we are publishing them!

[b]Changes:
[/b][list]
[*] added three new buildings
[*] reworked all unit types and actions
[*] added upkeep cost
[*] added buildings effects
[*] upgraded the enemy's behaviour and balanced it
[*] added giving resources to neutral villages
[*] added water tiles
[*] changed map generation process
[*] added small effects of unit actions
[*] added reappearing clouds and reshaping terrain
[*] added enemy's settlers unit
[*] reworked UI
[*] added descriptions to some objects
[*] fixed many bugs
[*] added many balance tweaks
[/list]

Please let us know what you think: [url=https://forms.gle/4ZuBTpQguSYaguc7A]https://forms.gle/4ZuBTpQguSYaguc7A[/url]
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Trailer and release date!
notes.notes:
First, big thanks to all the people who enlisted in the playtests, I was not expecting such numbers! Please remember to share your opinion either in the comments, via mail (vaeril.games@gmail.com) or in the survey ([url=https://forms.gle/7CxLKUWYPygamqaTA]https://forms.gle/7CxLKUWYPygamqaTA[/url]).

notes.title: Playtesting is here!
notes.notes:
You can now sign up for playtesting!

Once you play, please comment this event, fill out the ([url=https://forms.gle/gC16hAiYseQNwshS8]form[/url]),​ or contact vaeril.games@gmail.com to share your thoughts!

notes.title: Playtesting starts in a week!
notes.notes:
Welcome all!

The screenshots have just been updated to show the current game state better. All the while, changes are made and existing mechanics are developed.

Apart from many bug fixes, roads were added and resource costs of everything were balanced.

But the most important news is playtesting starting soon. The playtest demo will be available here, on Steam, and itch.io. Any plays are very much welcome. The idea behind this demo is to make the game better, so even if you'll play only for a little time, comment or write to vaeril.games@gmail.com with your feedback. Thanks in advance!

notes.title: Devlog: Enemy AI
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've finished the first enemy AI patterns a week ago. The enemies seek player units and villages but also patrol their own villages and call for reinforcements if player forces are too big.

Together with several units available, village building system and map generation, it makes the development progress big enough to bring together a demo. We plan the first soon, in a few weeks. 
If you are interested in playing and sending us your thoughts, read our posts!

In the meantime, thanks to all who wishlisted, and have a Happy New Year!
